rule: reaction_for (ASSUMED): lethal -> Death01; head/neck -> Hit_Head; incapacitating leg -> Hit_Knockback (fall); severe -> Hit_Knockback; else Hit_Chest. Parry (blade-to-blade distance <= PLACEHOLDER blade width before any body contact, in the strike phase: tip approaching the defender and blade pointing at it) -> attacker Hit_Chest recoil, no wound. Defender blend-in per clip: Death01 2, Hit_Knockback 2, Hit_Head 4, Hit_Chest 6 frames
limitations: defender reacts only after the first contact (no anticipation)
reactions start the frame after contact; NLA blend-in per clip (ASSUMED table)
strike-phase filter uses only signs (ASSUMED): tip motion towards the defender and blade direction along the facing axis; a cut moving sideways at the moment of contact may be filtered
parry = blade centre lines within the PLACEHOLDER blade width; the defender plays no parry clip and only the attacker recoils (no blocked-hit clip in the CC0 libraries)
no dedicated fall/stagger clips: Hit_Knockback stands in for a fall, Hit_Chest for a stagger
attacker reaction is one recovery clip for every hit (ASSUMED)
stance shorter than the attack holds its last pose
contact measured against block-dummy capsules (envelope radii ESTIMATE)
